description_en: Retrieves the details of a resource pool
name: GetPool

parameters.help_en:
The resource pool name.
The name can be up to 15 characters in length.
The name can contain digits, uppercase letters, lowercase letters, underscores (_), and periods (.)
parameters.help_zh:

长度不超过15个字符。
可包含数字、大写字母、小写字母、下划线（_）和点（.）
parameters.name: pool_name
